videos.title: The Fantastic Water Babes
videos.description: After losing her boyfriend, Gill, a vengeful girl, joins the Fantastic Water Babes swimming competition against her romantic rival and her friends, even though she doesn't know how to swim. When celebrity swimmer Yuen doesn't follow through on his promise to help her, Gill kidnaps him to make him teach her and her friends how to swim.

videos.title: Sisters in Law
videos.description: Following the caseload of a group of feisty female legal professionals tackling cases from marital violence and kidnapping to child abuse and rape. In the little town of Kumba, Cameroon, there have been no convictions in marital abuse cases for nearly two decades. Thanks to the dynamic and tenacious State Prosecutor Vera Ngassa, Court President Beatrice Ntuba and others, things are about to change.

videos.title: New Blood
videos.description: Alan White (John Hurt) is a desperate man; his daughter must have a heart transplant to live. He gets an unexpected visit from his adult son, Danny (Nick Moran), a criminal who hasn't spoken to his family in years. Danny lost track of a man marked for death and is afraid to face his merciless crime boss. In Danny's plight, Alan sees a way to save both of his children -- already prepared to die in order to donate his heart to his daughter, he will stand in for Danny's escaped hostage.
